page.overview:
Who is Sealas?

Sealas (Fused) heavily resembles its fusees' various traits. He possesses Ahms' yellow eyes, black skin and a pale-blue glowing core on his chest, along with Sealas' white hair and physical build. he also wears a red-colored ripped long backside cloth, and he also wields a blue glowing spear that has Ahms' features present on it.

Sealas (Fused) retains Sealas' personality due to Ahms' lack of a will of it's own.

Now that he has the power required to fulfill his goal, he is ready to carry out his plan to burn the Scroll of Eternity which will allow him to rewrite history as he sees fit thus can finally fulfill his utopian ideal of creating a "just" Multiverse as he views the current one as "unjust". Though he considers the Time Patrol and Dragon Ball Heroes' decision to challenge him as defying all logic, he welcomes it noting that he could not ask for better practice, confident they are powerless before his newfound power which he wishes to test against their combined might that had bested him and Ahms previously and forced Sealas' to enact the final phase of his plan ahead of schedule.

Like Sealas and Ahms, he shows no qualms about hurting/killing young children if it means achieving his goal as he plans on erasing the current history anyways thus, he has an "ends justifies the means" mentality.
